A map of lists. mixed has one value of every kind, with two numbers that are equal but written differently and two strs that differ only in case. escaped has strs whose literals contain escapes, so the order shows that a str is compared as the text it stands for. lists has lists that are the start of one another and a list inside a list. maps has maps with different keys, maps with the same keys and different values, a map whose keys are in another order, and a map whose keys are the start of another's. none is empty and one has a single element. The calls show the order of the kinds, that equal elements keep their order, that the elements are renumbered with the lines under them unchanged, what the empty list returns, and that a document that is not a list fails.
